issue_title: Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
issue_text:
Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping

When creating a pipeline using pipenv, the Pipfile would get corrupted in certain cases: when there are multiple entries in an array of tables and the last one is at the end of the file AND does not have a final newline.

```python
import tomlkit

toml_str = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''

parsed = tomlkit.loads(toml_str)
print(tomlkit.dumps(parsed))
```

Wrong output:

```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]
```

The dumped output is no longer valid TOML — re-parsing it raises `UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '['`. The tables after the last array-of-tables entry get glued onto the previous line.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_381_parse_aot_without_ending_newline_roundtrip
success_criteria: The selected test passes; dumping a parsed document whose last array-of-tables entry lacks a trailing newline produces valid TOML that round-trips losslessly.
